description:
The company 'Innova GmbH' has rebranded to 'Innova Global'. Update all visitor records in the database to reflect this change. 

1. Search for all visitors associated with 'Innova GmbH'.
2. Edit their records to change the Company Name to 'Innova Global'.
3. Ensure the change is saved.

Do not modify any other visitor details (Name, Host, etc.).
